releases.name: v1.1.0
releases.body:
First post-Jam update.
- Slightly reworked ending to make some previously inaccessible epilogue dialogue accessible again.
- Added a map mode icon for the Egg Star.
- Fixed a shader issue preventing certain egg-shaped characters from being visible.
- Other minor fixes and tweaks.
releases.bodyZh:
首个Jam更新后帖子。
- 稍微重新设计了结局，使一些之前无法访问的尾声对话再次可访问。
- 为蛋星添加了地图模式图标。
- 修复了一个着色器问题，导致某些蛋形角色无法显示。
- 其他一些小的修复和调整。

releases.name: v1.0.0
releases.body:
- Official Jam release candidate!
- Rebalancing and many quality-of-life and functionality tweaks
- Expanded NPC cast and extended ending cutscene
- New Ernesto hiding spot
releases.bodyZh:
- 官方Jam发布候选版本！
- 平衡性调整及多项品质生活和功能微调
- 扩展NPC阵容和延长结局过场动画
- 新的Ernesto藏身地点
